newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt paint firm 95/96 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt paint firm 95/96 profit up.

text.p: Paints and Chemical Industries said on Tuesday that net after-tax profit rose in the financial year 1995/96 to 103.93 million pounds compared with 103.76 million pounds in the previous year.
The financial years end on June 30.
Published results showed that shareholders portion of the profits was 55 million pounds in 1995/96. That compares with 50 million pounds in 94/95.
The firm said it would distribute 5.50 pounds per share against 5.00 pounds in the previous year.
The company decided in August to split the shares 10 for one, making 10 million shares with a nominal value of 10 pounds.
Shareholders' equity rose to 281.121 million pounds in 1995/96 compared with 240.981 million in 1994/95.
The shares last traded at 875.25 on November 19, a year high.
